contentList.text: Adsorption equilibria and kinetics of CO2, CH4, CO, N2, and H2 on KOH-treated activated carbon pellet

Suk-Hoon Hong, Kyounghee Chung, Gina Bang, Kyung-Min Kim, Chang-Ha Lee. This abstract paragraph is long enough to be captured as pre-heading body text when it appears before the first heading in the document flow.
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cej.2021.133396 Received 14 September 2021; 1385-8947/© 2021 Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved.
Hydrogen is a promising clean energy carrier, and pressure swing adsorption (PSA) is widely used to purify hydrogen from reformer off-gas streams containing CO2, CH4, CO, and N2 impurities.

list_items: Step 1: activate the carbon precursor with KOH at 1073 K.
Step 2: wash the sample until the filtrate reaches neutral pH.
Step 3: dry under vacuum before adsorption measurements.

contentList.text: The KOH-treated activated carbon showed markedly higher CO2 adsorption capacity than the pristine sample across the studied pressure range.
